subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the young woman from <Picture 1> and <Picture 2>, with long wavy blonde hair, wearing a black overcoat over a black turtleneck, a floral patterned scarf (red, black, and grey), and black slip-on shoes.
<Subject 2> is the athletic cyclist from <Picture 1> and <Picture 3>, with dark hair, a black cycling helmet, a black thermal windbreaker jacket, black cycling tights, and black cycling shoes.

summary:
[keyframe completion + reference generation] The target video shows <Subject 1> walking briskly against the flow of pedestrian traffic at a lively city crosswalk. As she moves, a sudden gust of wind catches her floral scarf, sending the fringes fluttering, causing her to grab the fabric to keep it secure. <Subject 2> rides a bicycle past her, maintaining visual consistency. The scene captures a candid, commercial-style moment in a dynamic urban environment.

detailed_description:
The video is a 6-second, 16:9 cinematic commercial-style clip with high color saturation, emphasizing a warm coral and high-contrast black aesthetic. The scene takes place on a sunny day at a bustling New York City crosswalk, characterized by sharp shadows and bright daylight.

[Shot 1] The shot opens exactly on the frame from <Picture 1>: a high-angle medium shot of <Subject 1> walking towards the camera at a fast clip. She holds a smartphone in her right hand and a white coffee cup in her left, which displays the text "Bío Ynsuí". Behind her, <Subject 2> is biking forward, moving from the mid-right background towards the foreground. At 00:01.000, a sudden gust of wind sweeps across the frame from right to left. <Subject 1>'s floral scarf (matching the coral tones seen in <Subject 4>) lifts and flutters dramatically. As it threatens to slip or fly away, <Subject 1> immediately extends her hand to grab the fabric, pulling it tighter around her neck. The camera performs a smooth handheld Truck Left movement with small amplitude and steady speed, tracking her forward motion against the flow of background pedestrians. The city traffic and distant high-rises remain consistent, with yellow taxis visible in the background. <Subject 1> maintains a professional yet surprised expression, reacting to the wind.

overall_soundscape:
Loud city traffic and a constant wash of crowd noise form the baseline. Distinct swishing sounds of the scarf fluttering in the wind and the rhythmic clicking of a crosswalk signal are audible throughout the clip.
